note: The enemy forces a planet can carry, and the game's effect numbers that mean each one. The war marks a planet with bare numbers (war-effects.json names them); this table says which of those numbers is a subfaction, which front it belongs to, and how it changes the enemy list. effects is empty for a subfaction nobody has seen on the map yet: it is never present until its number is added. variant is the label enemies.json gives that subfaction's own enemies, from the wiki's categories. adds names enemies the label misses. removes names the regular enemies it replaces, each a name or { name, from } where it only replaces them from a difficulty. restores, on Invasion Fleet only, puts back everything another subfaction on the same planet removed. Every line comes from the subfaction's page on helldivers.wiki.gg, read 12 October 2026, and source names it.

predator-strain.name: Predator Strain
predator-strain.say: Faster Terminids that flank. Predator Hunters cloak. Fire and gas break the cloak.

rupture-strain.name: Rupture Strain
rupture-strain.say: Warriors, Spewers and Chargers burrow. Explosions force them up. A Rupture Spewer bursts on death.

spore-burst-strain.name: Spore Burst Strain
spore-burst-strain.say: Faster Terminids in bigger patrols. Their spores make nearby bugs faster. A bug killed while burning releases none.

hive-lords.name: Hive Lords
hive-lords.say: One Hive Lord per mission from difficulty 7. 150,000 health, follows you underground, needs anti-tank.

dragonroaches.name: Dragonroaches
dragonroaches.say: Flying Terminids that breathe fire, from difficulty 5, in place of Bile Titans. The wings are unarmoured.

hive-world.name: Hive World
hive-world.say: 20% fewer reinforcements, Eagles rearm 30% slower, pickups give half the ammo. Shrieker swarms and Bug Mines.

jet-brigade.name: The Jet Brigade
jet-brigade.say: Automatons with jump packs. A destroyed pack explodes and sets fire to everything near it.

incineration-corps.name: The Incineration Corps
incineration-corps.say: Automatons with flamethrowers and incendiary rounds. The Shield Generator Pack stops incendiary rounds.

cyborgs.name: Cyborgs
cyborgs.say: Radicals sprint as fast as a Helldiver and knock you down. Agitators make nearby Automatons faster.

mindless-masses.name: Mindless Masses
mindless-masses.say: Huge numbers of Voteless and more Fleshmobs. No Stingrays and no Elevated Overseers.

appropriators.name: Appropriators
appropriators.say: Illuminate and their machines only. No Voteless, Fleshmobs or Stingrays. Obtruders explode on death.

vote-snatchers.name: Vote Snatchers
vote-snatchers.say: Crushers and Wretches in place of Overseers, Harvesters, Watchers and Stingrays. No reinforcement calls.

invasion-fleet.name: Invasion Fleet
invasion-fleet.say: The full Illuminate force, on top of any other subfaction here.

exostorm-1.name: Exostorm class 1
exostorm-1.say: The weather is permanent. Destroying the Exospire core ends most of it.

exostorm-2.name: Exostorm class 2
exostorm-2.say: More lightning, and tornadoes that kill anything they pick up. Destroying the Exospire core ends most of it.

exostorm-3.name: Exostorm class 3
exostorm-3.say: Constant lightning that kills in medium or light armour. Heavy loss of visibility.

knownGaps: The Acid, Predator and Armored Brood and the Panzer, Assault and Phalanx Division are real effect numbers (1117 to 1122, named in war-effects.json from the Helldivers 2 Companion's labels). The game says only that you will meet them during operations, and the wiki has no page for any of them, so none is in this table.
The Appropriators bring the Gatekeeper, the Obtruder and the Veracitor, and the wiki's enemy tables carry none of the three yet, so the enemy list cannot add them.
The Great Host is a past subfaction and the Void a past event. Neither is in this table.

Spore Burst Strain (1386), the Surges (1355, 1357, 1359) and the Exostorm classes (1373 to 1375) take their numbers from the Helldivers 2 Companion's list of the game's effects, read 12 October 2026. None was on the map that day, so none is yet checked against the game's own planet card.
